messages.subject: [NMOF-news] Summer School on Heuristic Optimization Methods in Data Analysis
messages.subject_clean: [NMOF-news] Summer School on Heuristic Optimization Methods in Data Analysis
messages.body_plain:
*Summer School on Heuristic Optimization Methods in Data Analysis*

July 9-13, 2012 in Rauischholzhausen, Germany


Organizer
   Peter Winker, University of Giessen

Lecturers
   Manfred Gilli, University of Geneva
   Dietmar Maringer, University of Basel and University of Geneva
   Enrico Schumann, VIP Value Investment Professionals AG, Wilen (SZ)


The summer school will focus on computational methods for statistics and 
data analysis; the content of the course will to a large part be based 
on the textbook "Numerical Methods and Optimization in Finance".

For more information, please visit

http://www.iasc-isi.org/announcements/183

http://www.unige.ch/ses/dsec/ssr.html
